description:
Amendment 002: The purpose of this amendment is update formating on the Pricing Table.  No other changes have been made. 

 Amendment 001 provides the Q&A and updates to the Solicitation, Pricing Worksheet, Past Performance Questionnaire. The Proposal and Past Performance Questionnaire due date is extended to December 4, 2026.  No other changes have been made. 

 The United States Senate office of the Sergeant at Arms (SAA) requires a Contractor to provide, implement, configure, host, maintain, and support a secure, fully customizable employee wellbeing application that serves as a centralized digital portal for organization-approved wellbeing programs, resources, events, educational opportunities, and engagement activities.
